description: Activate when: user says 'our growth is slowing and we need to figure out what's next', 'we keep doubling down on the core but I'm worried about disruption', 'when is the right time to start something new alongside the main business', 'should we diversify now or wait', 'competitors are moving into adjacent spaces'. Do NOT activate when: the company has not yet reached product-market fit; resources are so constrained that any investment outside the core would kill the business. More: deciqai.com/c/second-curve
